DAL.week5_result: L 16-24 vs TB (Thursday Night Football, Oct 8). Dallas fell to 2-3 and lost to a previously winless Tampa Bay team playing without Baker Mayfield; Dak Prescott went 24/42 for 316 yds with 2 INT (first multi-INT game of 2026) and Dallas lost the turnover battle 3-0. WR CeeDee Lamb (quad bruise) and LT Tyler Guyton (back) exited late; CB Joey Porter Jr. was a late scratch with illness.

WAS.week5_result: T 27-27 (OT) vs NYG (Oct 11, Landover). Jayden Daniels returned from a dislocated left elbow (wearing a brace) and ran 9 times for 103 yds and 2 TD, but Washington failed to get a game-winning FG off after Daniels scrambled in bounds with no timeouts as OT expired. Washington is 1-3-1; Dan Quinn called the tie 'a loss' and is under hot-seat scrutiny.

qb.notes: Daniels started Week 5 after missing two games with the elbow and played the whole game in a brace; Quinn said he 'played sharp'. Veteran backup Marcus Mariota (sprained right MCL, Week 4) was out in Week 5 and the rookie Kaliakmanis is the active backup; Mariota's earliest return is this game (Rotowire est. 10/19) but it is not certain.

SF.week5_result: W 32-29 at SEA (Oct 11). San Francisco moved to 5-0 on an Eddy Pineiro 43-yd FG with 1:56 left after Seattle committed 3 turnovers; Brock Purdy 19/29 for 189 yds, 2 TD, 1 INT, McCaffrey 68 rush yds and a TD, Brandin Cooks caught the go-ahead TD.
